turns.text: I don't know how is it for you guys. But for me the most difficult is to stay in this uncertainty. And you know, I trick my brain. Now I see uncertainty as excitement, as interest. I'm interesting how this day going to go. Because believe me before we knew exactly what's going to happen. Sunday and then it's going to be Monday, going to work, going to do this. Now every day is exciting. Fear and excitement, just two sides of the same coin.
